grades.lower_bound_mechanism: geometric partition with incomplete superincreasing induction
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: split construction and incomplete subset-sum lemma
grades.notes: The correct closed form and claiming-phase reduction are stated. Both all-n bounds remain explicitly open: the lower bound lacks the largest-piece insertion step, while the upper bound depends on Lemma X1 proved only for small m. Small-n cases and several restricted regimes are established.
